question: In the run with the highest incineration temperature, what gas velocity and P/Fe/Na ratio were used?
question_long: In the sewage sludge co-incineration run with the highest incineration temperature, what gas velocity and P/Fe/Na ratio were used?
rendered: According to page 3, in the run with the highest incineration temperature (900 °C), the P/Fe/Na ratio was 0.4/3/1 and the gas velocity was 1.3 times the minimum fluidization velocity (Umf).
